DECLARE
 G_TYPE VARCHAR2(10) := :CTRL_BLOCK.goal_type;
 G_MONTH VARCHAR2(4) := :CTRL_BLOCK.G_MONTH;
 g_year VARCHAR2(4) := :ctrl_blOCk.YEAR;
 p_opt varchar2(2) := :ctrl_block.percent_opt;
begin
 execute_trigger('KEY-CLRFRM');
 check_package_failure;
 :CTRL_BLOCK.goal_type := G_TYPE ;
 :CTRL_BLOCK.G_MONTH := G_MONTH ;
 :ctrl_blOCk.YEAR := g_year;
 :ctrl_block.percent_opt := p_opt;
 --IF :ctrl_block.year != :GLOBAL.year THEN
 -- :GLOBAL.year := :ctrl_block.year;
 POP_RECDS_SEP(:ctrl_block.YEAR);
 -- END IF;
 DISPLAY_ALL(:ctrl_block.YEAR);
 IF :ctrl_block.percent_opt = 1 THEN
 set_item_property('FIXED_BLOCK.JAN4',PROMPT_TEXT,'Act/Goal %:');
 set_item_property('MOB_BLOCK.JAN4',PROMPT_TEXT,'Act/Goal %:');
 set_item_property('TOT_BLOCK.JAN4',PROMPT_TEXT,'Act/Goal %:');
 ELSE
 set_item_property('FIXED_BLOCK.JAN4',PROMPT_TEXT,'Act/Proj %:');
 set_item_property('MOB_BLOCK.JAN4',PROMPT_TEXT,'Act/Proj %:');
 set_item_property('TOT_BLOCK.JAN4',PROMPT_TEXT,'Act/Proj %:');
 END IF;
 If :ctrl_block.goal_type ='BOT' and :ctrl_block.g_month != 'ALL' then
 set_bgnd('FIXED_BLOCK',:CTRL_BLOCK.G_MONTH,'E');
 set_bgnd('MOB_BLOCK',:CTRL_BLOCK.G_MONTH,'E');
 set_bgnd('TOT_BLOCK',:CTRL_BLOCK.G_MONTH,'E');
 End if; 
 If :ctrl_block.goal_type = 'FIX' then
 set_bgnd('FIXED_BLOCK',:CTRL_BLOCK.G_MONTH,'E');
 set_bgnd('MOB_BLOCK',:CTRL_BLOCK.G_MONTH,'D');
 set_bgnd('TOT_BLOCK',:CTRL_BLOCK.G_MONTH,'D');
 End if;
 If :ctrl_block.goal_type = 'MOB' then
 set_bgnd('MOB_BLOCK',:CTRL_BLOCK.G_MONTH,'E');
 set_bgnd('FIXED_BLOCK',:CTRL_BLOCK.G_MONTH,'D');
 set_bgnd('TOT_BLOCK',:CTRL_BLOCK.G_MONTH,'D');
 End if;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: SET_BGND
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE Set_bgnd (blk_name varchar2,col_name varchar2,ed_str varchar2 ) IS
i number := 1;
fld_name varchar2(50);
tfld_name varchar2(50);
My_date date := To_date('01-' || to_char(sysdate,'MON-YYYY'),'DD-MON-YYYY');
v_va varchar2(20); 
e_va varchar2(20);
d_va varchar2(20);
tmp_fld varchar2(50);
begin
I := 1;
for i in 1..13 loop
 for j in 1..4 loop
 If i < 13 then
 fld_name := blk_name ||'.'|| to_char(My_date,'MON')|| j ;
 tfld_name := blk_name || '.' || to_char(My_date,'MON')||'4';
 else
 fld_name := blk_name ||'.'|| 'TOTAL'|| j ;
 tfld_name := blk_name || '.' ||'TOTAL'||'4';
 End if;
 If Name_in(tfld_name) is not null and i < 13 then 
 If Name_in(tfld_name) > 100 then
 v_va := 'ABOVE100';
 elsif Name_in(tfld_name) >= 90 and Name_in(tfld_name) < 100 then
 v_va := 'ABOVE90';
 elsif Name_in(tfld_name) < 90 then
 v_va := 'BELOW90';
 end if;
 e_va := v_va || 'S';
 d_va := v_va;
 If to_char(My_date,'MON') = col_name or col_name = 'ALL' then 
 If ed_str ='E' then
 set_item_property(fld_name, visual_attribute,e_va);
 else
 set_item_property(fld_name, visual_attribute,d_va);
 End if;
 Else
 set_item_property(fld_name,visual_attribute,d_va);
 End if;
 End if; 
 End loop;
 My_date := Add_months(My_date,1);
end loop;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: POP_RECDS_SEP
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE POP_RECDS_SEP(yr in varchar2 default '1999') IS
 J_rg RECORDGROUP;
 j_col GROUPCOLUMN;
 j_month GROUPCOLUMN;
 j_errcode NUMBER;
 st_date date;
 end_date date;
 i number := 0;
 Y_char_hold varchar2(4) := 'xxxx';
 M_char_hold varchar2(6);
 fix_goal number;
 fix_proj number;
 fix_act number;
 mob_goal number;
 mob_proj number;
 mob_act number;
 rowcount number;
 row_num number;
 ctr number := 0;
BEGIN
 j_rg := FIND_GROUP('RG' || yr);
 IF ID_NULL(j_rg) THEN
 j_rg := CREATE_GROUP('RG'||yr);
 ELSE
 return;
 END IF;
 INITIALIZE_LOAD;
 if ID_NULL(j_rg) then
 return;
 end if;
 set_application_property(cursor_style,'BUSY');
 message('Working ...',no_acknowledge);
 --pitss synchronize;
 st_date := to_date('01-01-' || yr,'MM-DD-RRRR');
 end_date := last_day(st_date);
 j_col := Add_group_column(j_rg,'Month',char_column,2);
 j_col := Add_group_column(j_rg,'COL1_1', Number_column); -- Fixed Goal
 j_col := Add_group_column(j_rg,'COL1_2', Number_column); -- Fixed Proj
 j_col := Add_group_column(j_rg,'COL1_3', Number_column); -- Fixed Actual 
 j_col := Add_group_column(j_rg,'COL2_1', Number_column); -- Mob Goal
 j_col := Add_group_column(j_rg,'COL2_2', Number_column); -- Mob Proj
 j_col := Add_group_column(j_rg,'COL2_3', Number_column); -- Mob Actual
 Row_num := 1;
 IF to_number(yr) > to_number(to_char(sysdate,'YYYY')) THEN
 :TRY.L_CTR := 36;
 ELSIF to_number(yr) < to_number(to_char(sysdate,'YYYY')) THEN
 :TRY.L_CTR := 48;
 ELSE
 :TRY.L_CTR := 36 + to_number(to_char(sysdate,'MM'));
 END IF;
 for i in 1..12 loop
 message('Loading Data for '||yr || ' - ' || to_char(st_date,'MON'),no_acknowledge);
 Add_Group_Row( j_rg, END_OF_GROUP ); 
--message(st_date);pause; 
 Begin
 Select sum(goal_count) into fix_goal
 from goals
 where goals.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 and goal_type ='FXGOL' 
 and substr(goal_mmyy,1,2)= to_char(st_date,'MM')
 and substr(goal_mmyy, 5,2) = to_char(st_date, 'YY') ;
 Exception
 When others then 
 null;
 End;
 DISP_LOAD_DATA;
 Begin
 Select sum(goal_count) into mob_goal
 from goals
 where goals.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 and goal_type ='FLGOL' 
 and substr(goal_mmyy,1,2)= to_char(st_date,'MM')
 and substr(goal_mmyy, 5,2) = to_char(st_date, 'YY') ;

 Exception
 When others then 
 null;
 End;
 DISP_LOAD_DATA;
 Declare
 cursor c1 is
 Select decode(drive_type,'F','F','M') typ, sum(projected_draw) cnt
 from drives 
 where drive_date between st_date and end_date
 --and chapter_id = 'WAD'
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 group by decode(drive_type,'F','F','M');
 Begin
 fix_proj := 0;
 mob_proj := 0;
 for c1_rec in c1
 loop
 if c1_rec.typ = 'F' THEN
 fix_proj := c1_rec.cnt;
 else
 mob_proj := c1_rec.cnt;
 end if;
 end loop;
 END;
 DISP_LOAD_DATA; 
 IF st_date <= sysdate THEN
 Declare
 cursor c1 is 
 Select decode(drive_type,'F','F','M') typ, count(unit_id) cnt
 from donations d, drives dr
 where unit_id = unit_id
 and d.coll_Date between st_date and end_date
 and d.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and d.drive_id = dr.drive_id
 and dr.chapter_id = d.chapter_id
 group by decode(drive_type,'F','F','M');
 Begin 
 fix_act := 0;
 mob_act := 0;
 for c1_rec in c1
 loop
 if c1_rec.typ = 'F' THEN
 fix_act := c1_rec.cnt;
 else
 mob_act := c1_rec.cnt;
 end if;
 end loop;
 END;
 DISP_LOAD_DATA; 
 ELSE
 /* Future Dates */
 fix_act := 0;
 mob_act := 0;
 END IF; 
 set_group_char_cell('RG'||yr||'.'||'Month',i,to_char(st_date,'MM'));
 set_group_number_cell('RG'||yr||'.'||'COL1_1',i,fix_goal);
 set_group_number_cell('RG'||yr||'.'||'COL1_2',i,fix_proj);
 set_group_number_cell('RG'||yr||'.'||'COL1_3',i,fix_act);
 set_group_number_cell('RG'||yr||'.'||'COL2_1',i,mob_goal);
 set_group_number_cell('RG'||yr||'.'||'COL2_2',i,mob_proj);
 set_group_number_cell('RG'||yr||'.'||'COL2_3',i,mob_act);

 st_date := add_months(st_date,1);
 end_date := last_day(st_date);
 end loop;
 :TRY.L_DONE := :TRY.L_CTR;
 set_application_property(cursor_style,'DEFAULT');
 message('',no_acknowledge);
 --pitss synchronize;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CALC_PERCENT
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION CALC_PERCENT(P_OPT IN NUMBER, P_BLK IN NUMBER, P_FLD IN VARCHAR2)
RETURN NUMBER IS
 v_blk_name varchar2(30);
 v_num varchar2(60);
 v_denom varchar2(60);
BEGIN
 IF p_blk = 1 THEN
 v_blk_name := 'FIXED_BLOCK.';
 ELSIF p_blk = 2 THEN
 v_blk_name := 'MOB_BLOCK.';
 ELSE
 v_blk_name := 'TOT_BLOCK.';
 END IF;
 v_num := v_blk_name || p_fld || 3;
 v_denom := v_blk_name || p_fld || p_opt;
 IF name_in(v_num) is not null THEN
 return round((name_in(v_num) * 100)/ name_in(v_denom),2);
 ELSE
 return NULL;
 END IF;
EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 RETURN 0;
END;
